Liquid Glass KDE Widgets
https://github.com/jaxparrow07/liquidglass-kde-widgets
Upstream revision: ff196b4a688eccc7c8c858b3d53a76d8e7055719
License: GNU General Public License, version 3 (see the repository LICENSE).

Caelestia adapts the liquid-glass, crop and Dual Kawase shaders, and the
squircle ray-intersection approach used by the clock's TickRing component.
The upstream shader credits iyinchao/liquid-glass-studio for its refraction
model; that credit is retained in desktopglass.frag.

The weather forecast layouts, music card layouts and album/lyrics flip,
world-clock faces and city layouts, and timer wheels and preset layout are
adapted from the upstream weather, music, city-* and timer packages.

The host integration, shared wallpaper capture, transform mapping, settings
and widget data bindings have been adapted for Quickshell. Apple fonts and
icons bundled by the upstream project are not included in this adaptation.
